content:
alex: Deploy attempt failed for canary -> staging. Deploybot reported compat-suite failures on the new artifact, blocking the release window in 30m. Logs below.

deploybot: Promote attempt failed for artifact sha: deadbeef. Reason: compat-tests returned non-zero exit code. See job https://ci.internal/teams/release/7890 (job 7890).

ci-bot: ```
=== FAILURES ===
tests/test_serde_backward.py::test_backward_compat
E   AssertionError: missing field 'metadata'

-- Expected serde runtime: v1.2.0
-- Artifact built against serde: v1.3.0
Exit code: 1
```

sarah: Is this the serde bump that went in yesterday? @matt you touched the base image libs, right?

matt: Yeah — I bumped serde to 1.3.0 in the staging Dockerfile to fix a flaky encoding error. It passed unit tests locally but apparently broke the compat-suite.

jen: Two options: revert the bump (fast), or add a backward-compat shim in runtime and run full compat-suite (slower). Revert is safest for this change window.

alex: Change window closes in ~30m. Do we pin to v1.2.x and re-promote, or abort the release? Need quick call.

oncall-lisa: Can we promote the last-good artifact tag instead? deploybot has a promote-previous command. That would avoid a rebuild and keep the window.

matt: Yes, we can promote `release-20260315-7` (last-good). But that skips the perf tweak in my commit. Is that acceptable to product?

sarah: :thinking_face: The perf tweak was minor — I think it's fine to revert and schedule the change for the next cycle with proper compat tests.

alex: OK action: matt revert the serde bump in PR #3456 and open a follow-up ticket to reintroduce it after adding a compat test. Then we'll rebuild and promote the new artifact. Who will run the promote?

matt: On it. Pushed revert to #3456 (https://git.internal/r/repo/pull/3456-revert-serde-bump). Kicking CI now.

ci-bot: Build succeeded. Artifact published: sha: abcdef123. Starting promote to staging...

deploybot: Promote succeeded: artifact abcdef123 -> staging. Canary rollout initiated. :shipit:

jen: I'll watch canary e2e for 15m and surface any regressions. If green, we'll proceed with the release window.

alex: Thanks. Release notes: call out reverted serde bump and follow-up ticket RWF-112 for reintroducing with compat-suite coverage.

sarah: Also add an explicit test for optional `metadata` field in compat-suite to prevent this regression.

alex: Closing thread once canary is green.
